Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git push -q -u origin fix/7-refresh-infinite-recursion 2>&1 && gh pr create --base main --head fix/7-refresh-infinite-recursion --title "Fix infinite recursion in refresh() on expired session" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
Fixes #7.

## Problem
`refresh()` in `src/auth.js` returned `refresh(session)` with the same expired session, so it recursed forever and the page froze once the cookie expired.

## Change
- `refresh(session, fetchSession)` returns the session unchanged when it is not expired.
- When it is expired, it returns `fetchSession()` once. No recursion.

## Review notes
- `fetchSession` does not exist in this repo (the issue refers to it, but no definition or import was found). I made it a parameter instead of importing a module that doesn't exist. Callers must now pass it in. If it should be a module import, the signature can change.
- `fetchSession()` is called as-is; if it is async, callers should `await` the result.
- No tests exist in the repo, and none were added.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
EOF
